create_gtn_graph: create a gtn Graph with start and final nodes for pattern recognition
add_node_to_graph: add a node to a gtn Graph with optional start and final flags
add_arc_to_graph: add an arc between two nodes in a gtn Graph with a symbol label
draw_gtn_graph: draw a gtn Graph to a PDF file with symbol labels for visualization
union_gtn_graphs: union multiple gtn Graphs into a single combined graph
